name: range_day_band_fade_003
mechanism: On NIFTY, range-bound sessions (ADX < 20, flat 5-minute VWAP slope) create a microstructure where VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms aggressively defend prices that deviate 0.05-0.10% from session VWAP — they treat every tick away from benchmark as a free fill opportunity and immediately place opposing limit orders. When 1-minute MFI simultaneously reaches extreme (≤22 or ≥78), it confirms that short-term buying or selling pressure has exhausted available counterparty interest, leaving only the VWAP algos on one side of the book. The 20-minute Bollinger band acts as a safety filter: if price has already pierced the band, the move is a regime break rather than an overreaction, and the fade is skipped. At 5-second resolution we enter the moment MFI exhaustion prints with a bullish/bearish close bar, capturing 5-8 option points of the first-leg VWAP reversion before the next directional impulse.
core_signal_oneliner: Price deviates from VWAP on a low-ADX range day while 1-minute MFI signals exhaustion, fading the deviation back toward VWAP
